title: Chern-Simons corner phase spaces in BF-BB theories
summary: We investigate an approach to determine corner Poisson brackets of fields restricted to codimension 2 and 3 surfaces in 4D theories, without making use of boundary conditions. Instead, within the example of BF-BB type theories, we show that the constraint/generator algebra on a partial Cauchy slice is enough to determine the Poisson brackets and a corner symplectic form, useful in extended phase space constructions or holography.
